libheif (Emscripten / JavaScript build) — HEIF/HEIC image decoder.
Licence: GNU LGPL v3.0 (see LICENSE-LGPL-3.0.txt and LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt). It includes libde265 (LGPL v3.0).
This file is used unmodified, as distributed in the heic2any project 0.0.4 (src/libheif.js, MIT-licensed wrapper
not used). It is loaded as a separate file only when a HEIC photo is opened, so it can be replaced by any
compatible libheif build.
Source code: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif and https://github.com/strukturag/libde265
Copy used: https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any/blob/master/src/libheif.js (commit 3428539, 2023-03-29)
